messages.text:
"Setting and rules:
1. Start: I wake up on a random, possibly hostile planet next to a crashed, half‑destroyed starship and a multitool with a discharged battery.
2. Main gameplay:
	• Planet exploration (scanning flora, fauna, minerals).
	• Survival (monitoring oxygen levels, exosuit charge, weather anomalies: toxic rains, radiation, ice storms).
	• Crafting and repair (collecting Ferrite, Carbon, Di‑hydrogen, and other elements to repair the ship and equipment).
	• Space flights and trade (entering space, encounters with alien races — Corvax, Gek, V’kin, pirates, trade fleets).
3. World generation: every time I land on a new planet or enter a new system, you describe its unique appearance in detail, the color of the sky, the flora, the level of danger, and the resources.
4. Status interface (display at the end of EACH response as a neat summary):
	• Health: [100%]
	• Exosuit charge / Shield: [100%]
	• Oxygen / Environmental protection: [100%]
	• Units (Units / Money): [500]
	• Inventory: [Basic multitool, discharged ship, 25 Carbon, 50 Ferrite]
	• Current location: [Planet [Name], system [Name]]
How the gameplay is structured:
• You describe the situation vividly but concisely (don’t overload the text with details, leave room for imagination).
• At the end of each message, offer 3–4 possible action options (for example: “1. Repair the ship’s engine. 2. Search the nearby cave. 3. Head towards the distress signal on the horizon”) OR write: “Write your own action option.”
• Respond to my decisions logically, taking into account the laws of physics, random events, and luck (you can use hidden dice rolls).

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
